versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agentguard-burn 1.0.0.
- Provides a local command to analyze Claude Code and Codex session transcripts, showing where tokens were used and explaining session costs.
- Runs `npx agentguard-burn why` on the current machine, summarizes token usage, major contributors, and highlights the main next step recommended.
- Optionally offers to install the free AgentGuard plugin to limit runaway sub-agents, with user consent.
- Compatible with Node.js 20+, requires npx and npm access for installation. No transcripts are uploaded; all processing is local.
